sloka: स दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं सङ्ख्ये शापाद्विभ्रष्टगौरवम् ।उवाच वचनं धीमान्युक्तं पैतामहे कुले ।। ७.१५.१७ ॥
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraṁ saṅkhye śāpādvibhraṣṭagauravam ।uvāca vacanaṁ dhīmānyuktaṁ paitāmahe kule ।। 7.15.17 ॥

translations.english: Having seen his brother in battle, whose glory was lost due to a curse, the wise Kubera spoke words appropriate for their paternal lineage.
